text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Politicians and businessmen from the German port city of Hamburg on Tuesday said businessmen should develop a positive outlook on Africa, saying the continent was no longer the stereotyped land of famine, wars and disasters.

- The Hamburg trade and investment conference on Zimbabwe ended on Tuesday with business persons acknowledging more information was needed to acquaint German investors with the southern African country's investment climate.
- Several municipal charges and fees in Zimbabwe's capital Harare will go up next Tuesday in line with the budget statement announced by the city council in June.
